'''Erdős Lectures in Discrete Mathematics and Theoretical Computer Science''' is a distinguished lecture series at [[Hebrew University of Jerusalem]] named after [[mathematician]] [[Paul Erdős]].<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.ma.huji.ac.il/conf/erdos.html |title=Erdős Lectures in Discrete Mathematics and Theoretical Computer Science |access-date=2018-02-21 |archive-date=2018-02-21 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180221101118/http://www.ma.huji.ac.il/conf/erdos.html |url-status=dead }}</ref>  It is bringing an outstanding mathematician or computer scientist to Israel every year in the Spring.  The subject of the lectures is [[Discrete Mathematics]] and [[Theoretical Computer Science]].  

The first lecture series took place in 1998.

==List of Erdős Lecturers==
* 1998: [[Alexander Razborov]] ([[Steklov Institute]], Russia), [[Jeff Kahn (mathematician)|Jeff Kahn]] ([[Rutgers University]], U.S.)
* 1999: [[Richard P. Stanley|Richard Stanley]] ([[MIT]], U.S.), [[Johan Håstad]] ([[Royal Institute of Technology]], Sweden)
* 2001: [[Joel Spencer]] ([[NYU]], U.S.)
* 2002: [[Madhu Sudan]] ([[NYU]], U.S.)
* 2003: [[Maria Chudnovsky]] ([[Princeton University]], U.S.)
* 2004: [[Imre Bárány]] ([[Alfréd Rényi Mathematical Institute]], Hungary)
* 2005: [[János Pach]] ([[NYU]], U.S.), [[Endre Szemerédi]] ([[Alfréd Rényi Institute of Mathematics]], Hungary)
* 2006: [[József Beck]] ([[Princeton University]], U.S.)
* 2007: [[Van H. Vu]] ([[Rutgers University]], U.S.)
* 2008: [[Henry Cohn]] ([[Microsoft Research]], U.S.)
* 2010: [[Éva Tardos]] ([[Cornell University]], U.S.)
* 2011: [[Günter M. Ziegler]] ([[Freie Universität Berlin]], Germany)
* 2012: [[Luca Trevisan]] ([[Stanford University]], U.S.)
* 2013: [[Michael Saks (mathematician)|Michael Saks]] ([[Rutgers University]], U.S.)
* 2014: [[Daniel Spielman]] ([[Yale University]], U.S.)
* 2015: [[Subhash Khot]] ([[NYU]], U.S.)
* 2016: [[June Huh]] ([[Institute for Advanced Study|IAS]] & [[Princeton University]], U.S.)
* 2017: [[József Solymosi]] ([[UBC]], Canada)
* 2018: [[Igor Pak]] ([[UCLA]], U.S.)<ref>[https://mathematics.huji.ac.il/node/67255 Erdős Lectures: Igor Pak (UCLA)]</ref>
* 2022: [[Shachar Lovett]] ([[UCSD]], U.S.)
